|birth = {{ne|972}}}}'''Valene Sural''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Valene Sural}} She was part of [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida's]] expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

== Appearance ==
Valene is new to the shawl, so she lacks the ageless look of the Aes Sedai.

==Strength and Abilities==
Valene has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|27}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

== History ==
She was born in [[972 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[988 NE]]. She was a [[novice]] for five years and [[Accepted]] for six. She was raised in [[999 NE]].

== Activities ==
Since Valene lacks the ageless look, she was chosen for the expedition to Cairhien.

After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]], she was sent with her group to [[Dorlan]] under the leadership of [[Covarla]].

==Notes==
Valene Sural is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books.
